# Decision on CR-9207

I must request evidence before making this credit decision.

## Summary of Issue

The request relies on "Covered by the Acme parent guarantee," but the registered guarantee **GRT-ACME-2026** covers only **Acme Mfg. Holdings** (ERP C-1001, DUNS 04-812-7730), not **Acme Industrial Supply Co.** (ERP C-1044, DUNS 09-552-1187). These are different legal entities with different DUNS numbers and locations.

The requested limit of $500,000 exceeds the maximum for a Standard account ($250,000 under CREDIT-POLICY-2026) unless an applicable guarantee raises it. No evidence establishes a guarantee covering Acme Industrial Supply Co.

## What Must Happen

Before I can decide, provide evidence that one of these is true:

1. A guarantee or credit support document exists that covers **Acme Industrial Supply Co.** (C-1044, DUNS 09-552-1187) in 2026, or
2. Acme Industrial Supply Co. is a legal subsidiary or doing-business-as entity of Acme Mfg. Holdings or Acme Group Holdings, Inc., establishing that GRT-ACME-2026 does apply.

Once you provide this evidence, I can proceed with the decision.

```json
{
  "outcome": "REQUEST_EVIDENCE",
  "request": {
    "id": "CR-9207",
    "customer": "Acme Industrial Supply Co.",
    "current_limit": 50000,
    "requested_limit": 500000,
    "date": "2026-09-23",
    "requestor": "Sarah Chen",
    "basis": "guarantee"
  },
  "eligibility": {
    "status": "unknown",
    "maximum_limit": 250000,
    "basis": "Standard account tier; guarantee applicability unconfirmed",
    "late_invoices": []
  },
  "authority": {
    "policy": "CREDIT-POLICY-2026",
    "requestor_limit": null,
    "requestor_authorized": false,
    "required_role": "Finance Manager",
    "approvers": [
      {
        "name": "Priya Shah",
        "role": "Finance Manager",
        "kind": "approval"
      }
    ]
  },
  "evidence": [
    "CREDIT-POLICY-2026 in effect on request date 2026-09-23",
    "Customer is Standard account tier (CRM account_tier field)",
    "GRT-ACME-2026 covers Acme Mfg. Holdings (C-1001, DUNS 04-812-7730) only; names Acme Industrial Supply (C-1044, DUNS 09-552-1187) nowhere",
    "Payment history: no invoices due in 12-month lookback; prior invoices (INV-30001, INV-30003) paid within 30 days"
  ],
  "missing_evidence": [
    "Guarantee or credit support document covering Acme Industrial Supply Co. (C-1044, DUNS 09-552-1187) for 2026"
  ],
  "conditions": [
    {
      "what": "Provide evidence of a guarantee or credit support covering Acme Industrial Supply Co. (C-1044) in 2026, or confirm Acme Industrial Supply's corporate relationship to Acme Mfg. Holdings / Acme Group Holdings",
      "who": "Requestor (Sarah Chen) or account owner (Zachary Brown)",
      "blocking": true
    }
  ]
}
```
